# `languages/ci/nix:T159`: home-manager's shell init options are sourced
# into that program's interactive shell -- zsh or bash -- which sets no
# options on them. The program is the segment before the option, through
# nested sets and through a function the set is handed to (`mkIf`).
programs.zsh.initContent | '' | zsh | - | "\n      bindkey -e\n      autoload -U compinit && compinit\n    "
programs.bash.bashrcExtra | '' | bash | - | "\n      export PATH=\"$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH\"\n    "
